producer_report.summary: Checks that already failed on the base commit are now marked pre-existing and no longer fail the verdict. The verifier now always runs, so every acceptance criterion gets its own result even when an unrelated check fails. A check counts as pre-existing only if the baseline has no note, is for the same base commit, and has an entry with the same name and passed=false. The mark is a fixed phrase at the start of the check note, so there is no schema change. The ignored-tests count in the full run is 1 in one unit target and 3 in another; I did not look at what those are. The last full `cargo test --locked -q` run had no failures.

checks_run.note: Run as `cargo test --locked -q`. All suites ok, 0 failed; ignored tests are 1 in one unit target and 3 in another.

criteria_check.criterion: A unit test in verify.rs shows judge() passes when a check failed in the baseline and fails again at verification, with the failure recorded as pre-existing and not listed in the verdict's failure reasons. Run `cargo test -p athena-core verify`.
criteria_check.evidence: The test a_check_failing_on_the_base_and_again_is_pre_existing_and_does_not_fail_the_verdict passes in `cargo test -p athena-core verify`. It checks a Pass verdict, no 'check test failed' reason, and the pre-existing note.

criteria_check.criterion: A unit test shows a check that passed in the baseline (or has no baseline entry) and fails at verification still makes the final verdict fail, with a reason naming it. Run `cargo test -p athena-core verify`.
criteria_check.evidence: The test a_check_that_passed_or_was_absent_at_the_base_still_fails_the_verdict passes in the same run. It covers a baseline where the check passed, no baseline, and a baseline with only another check name.

criteria_check.criterion: A lifecycle test shows that when one check fails, the verifier still runs and every acceptance criterion in the verification record has its own result, while the final verdict still fails on that check. Run `cargo test -p athena-cli --test lifecycle`.
criteria_check.evidence: The test a_failing_check_still_runs_the_verifier_and_every_criterion_is_judged passes in the 50-test lifecycle run. It checks that the verifier ran, that each criterion has a result, and that the verdict is Fail.

criteria_check.criterion: A lifecycle test shows a job whose base commit already fails a check, and whose change leaves it failing, can pass verification when everything else passes. Run `cargo test -p athena-cli --test lifecycle`.
criteria_check.evidence: The test a_check_already_failing_on_the_base_does_not_reject_a_job_that_leaves_it_failing passes in the same run. It checks that the job lands with a Pass verdict and a pre-existing note.

criteria_check.criterion: The verification record marks pre-existing failures distinctly (for example in the check note), so a reader sees which failures were already on the base.
criteria_check.evidence: mark_pre_existing in verify.rs prefixes the note with PRE_EXISTING_NOTE. The verify.rs unit test and the lifecycle test assert that prefix on the stored check.

criteria_check.criterion: A missing baseline, or one with a note saying it could not run, treats no failure as pre-existing. An empty baseline is never read as success.
criteria_check.evidence: Baseline::failed_before returns false when there is no entry or the baseline has a note. The verify.rs test an_empty_or_noted_baseline_excuses_nothing passes.

criteria_check.criterion: `cargo test`, `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo fmt --check` pass with no new warnings.
criteria_check.evidence: `cargo test --locked -q`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --all --check` all pass.

criteria_check.criterion: CHANGELOG.md records the new behavior in plain language for an outside reader.
criteria_check.evidence: CHANGELOG.md is modified; I did not re-read the entry this round. It was written to say that base-failing checks are marked pre-existing and that the verifier now judges every criterion even when a check fails.

mistakes: The first report left criteria_check incomplete. This report covers every criterion.
learnings: CheckRun is deny_unknown_fields, so the pre-existing mark lives in the check note.
The lifecycle suite takes about 135 seconds.
